package com.acme.order.service;

import com.acme.order.domain.Order;
import com.acme.order.domain.OrderSummary;
import com.acme.order.service.command.PlaceOrderCommand;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Order use-cases. Implementations are expected to be transactional.
 */
public interface OrderService {

    Order placeOrder(PlaceOrderCommand command);

    Order getOrder(Long orderId);

    Order cancelOrder(Long orderId, String reason);

    /** Shipping fee in cents for a zone and parcel weight. */
    int calculateFee(int zone, int weightGrams);

    /** Discount in basis points for an order line, e.g. 250 == 2.5% */
    int discountFor(int quantity);

    List<OrderSummary> listOpenOrders(String customerId);
}
